_comment: Subscript tokens: in prose written as BASE_TOKEN (i_lim, x_k, C_med, nFD_SC_S) the writers -- MS Drafts/scripts/apply_v81_fixes.py for the manuscript, make_si.js for the SI -- render TOKEN as a Word subscript run when it is the longest listed token that starts the alphanumeric run after the underscore AND either exhausts that run or is followed by another BASE_ symbol (nFD_SC_S); data/docx_text.py reads a subscript run back as '_' + text, so every gate phrase keeps its underscore form. Anything else (H_EXT, si_001) stays a literal underscore and is reported by the builders. No bare digits: they over-matched file names.
